courses.title: Relax and Rejuvenate with Avi Gordon
courses.description: A weekend at Yogaville led by Avi Gordon of the Integral Yoga Teachers Association, built around restorative yoga, guided meditation, a morning of Tai Chi and a guided hike. Sessions with Swami Vidyananda and others offer yogic tools for meeting everyday stress.

courses.title: Somatic & Spiritual Smiles: Uniting Yogic Wisdom and Western Psychology for Inner Joy
courses.description: A weekend retreat at Yogaville with Integral Yoga teacher Sampada (Sam) Desai that pairs yoga psychology with gentle somatic movement, breathwork and laughter practice. Participants learn simple body-based ways to ease stress and build a daily routine at home.

courses.title: Live, Laugh, Love! Free Laugha Yoga Workshop
courses.description: A free day-long workshop at Yogaville on 13 February 2027 with Bharata Wingham, who has led Laugha Yoga there since 1997. The day mixes laughter games, laughter breathing, meditation and a guided deep relaxation; lunch and lodging are extra.

left_out: The Calm Circuit: Neuro-Yoga Practices for Healing (29-31 Jan 2027, $349): the page says the practices support 'immune function, and reduced inflammation'; a claim on the not-allowed list, so still out.
Relax and Rejuvenate: the page shows no price, so 'Contact for pricing'.
flags: Somatic & Spiritual Smiles is led by a licensed counsellor and draws on 'evidence-based mental health principles'; kept as a yoga retreat (no cure or treatment claim).
Laugha Yoga workshop mentions laughter 'recognized as a therapeutic practice'; no claim to treat a condition; kept. Free, but entered as a dated offering (13 Feb 2027) so it drops off after the day.
